overall.preference: Flash packing3 as quality finalist; no production/global winner yet
overall.assessment: Flash materially avoids costly lite mistakes in contact genre, getaway-driver role and failed-heist leader, while preserving strong shared lists. The benefit is concentrated, not universal: many cases tie and professor/legal gains also occur with lite packing3. Flash still has weak tail conjunctions. On these 21 requests Flash average reported cost is about $0.00665 versus lite $0.00393 (about 69% higher), with reconstructed median end-to-end time about 8.37s versus 6.49s (about 29% higher). Versus prior v2 it is cheaper but slower. This supports testing a leaner Flash finalist, not silently accepting the latency premium or declaring flawless quality.
limitations: Same pools and already-inspected development/challenge requests; not fresh generalization evidence.
Latencies include reconstructed frozen upstream components; do not present them as a single freshly measured production end-to-end run.
Source annotation quality and explicit-constraint tail failures remain unresolved.
Final confirmation outputs were not inspected.
